unit: Unit 13: Making Your Computer Easier to Use
title: Inverting the colors
drDigitalIntro:
Inverting swaps light for dark across the entire screen.
• White pages become black, black text becomes white, and colors flip to their opposites.
• Many people find a bright white page painful to read for long stretches. Inverting removes the glare completely.
• It is the most dramatic change in this unit — do not be alarmed when the screen goes dark.
• The switch that turned it on turns it back off. Nothing is broken.

steps.say: Click Accessibility in the list on the left.
Click the switch next to Invert Colors. The whole screen will flip.

drDigitalSuccess: The whole computer flipped. Notice the switch is still there, ready to flip it back.
drDigitalHint: Invert Colors is the first switch in the Color and Contrast card. Scroll down inside the Settings window if you cannot see it.
warning: This lesson turns the whole screen dark. That is expected — the same switch turns it back.
